stories.title: Ticket editing with live preview and atomic save
acceptanceCriteria: The source pane is editable; the preview, generated HTML, task list, and markup problems for that item update live from the edited text.
Tree badges, the header markup chip, and the workspace problem count reflect the edited text without saving.

Save (button and Ctrl+S) writes the edited description blocks back into the backlog file atomically (temp file + rename), re-parses, rebuilds the tree, preserves selection, and clears the dirty state.
Save refuses to overwrite external on-disk changes and reports them instead.
Plan generation and Apply are refused while unsaved edits exist, with a message that says why.
Core gains tested primitives: parser line ranges for each item's description block and a BacklogSplicer that rewrites one item's block, preserving line endings and everything outside the block.

stories.title: Import CSV export matching gen-csv byte for byte
acceptanceCriteria: Core writes the same CSV csvio.py writes for the same parsed backlog: same columns, same quoting, same CRLF line endings (parity-tested against the real Python module).
The app can write the import CSV from the open profile to a chosen path without a PAT and without touching Azure DevOps.

stories.title: Onboarding and organization-config import enrichment
acceptanceCriteria: Opening an existing board.config.json surfaces a typed validation message on the onboarding screen (not the generic error panel) when the file is invalid.
The describe-one-here form validates before creating: a missing/unreadable backlog file, or a bad save path, reports a specific inline error.
After choosing a backlog file, a newly created profile can scaffold a starter backlog when none exists, so a brand-new organization onboards end to end.

stories.title: Deepen PRD, FSD, Architecture, and Design System
acceptanceCriteria: PRD: personas with jobs and pain, user journeys, release slices with acceptance mapping, success measures kept falsifiable.
FSD: screen-by-screen behaviour including the new editing flow, error taxonomy, data contracts, NFRs updated to what exists.
Architecture: module table matches the code as built (ranges, splicer, CSV export, save path), the diagram is current, risks current.
Design System: tokens match Theme.axaml as built, component inventory covers every control class in use, editing-state components specified.
Every claim is checked against the repository; no doc states behaviour that does not exist.

stories.title: Project tracking doc and live-doc sync
acceptanceCriteria: A PROJECT-TRACKING.md exists: milestone plan, ticket burn-down, dependency map, risk register, decision log.
STATUS.md, TRACEABILITY.md, GAPS.md, and BACKLOG.md are updated in the same change set to reflect everything this run delivered, with evidence.
The root README's stale 'desktop app is in the planning stage' claim is corrected.
